topic: The "help me decide" prompt: compare your options side by side and see what would change the answer
post:
Stuck between two options and going in circles? 🤔
This copy-paste prompt helps Claude help you decide.

The trick: don't just ask "Which is better?"
Tell Claude your options AND what matters to you.

Anthropic's own prompting guide says Claude does best with clear, direct instructions, and that explaining why something matters helps it give more targeted answers. 🎯

Copy this prompt 👇
"Help me decide between [option A] and [option B].
What matters most to me: [your top 3 priorities].
Make a simple table comparing both options on each priority.
Then give me your recommendation in 2 sentences, and tell me what would change your mind."

Example:
Two job offers. Priorities: pay, commute, growth. ✅

That last line is the secret 🔑
"What would change your mind" shows you which facts to double-check before you choose.

And remember: Claude helps you think. The decision is still yours.

Why it matters:
A clear comparison beats a sleepless night of pros and cons in your head. 💡

What decision would you run through this prompt? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.
